name: 909 kick
why: A punchy kick on every beat. Almost every style on this page is built on top of it.

ingredients.name: A plain kick
ingredients.adds: Four kicks to the bar from the default kit.

ingredients.name: The 909
ingredients.adds: The 909's hard click and short, tight body.
ingredients.listenFor: The attack gets sharper and the tail shorter.

ingredients.name: Level
ingredients.adds: The kick sits on top of everything else.

knobs.above: It clips and flattens the mix.
